summary: Ported end.c:disclose’s nonzero-achievement query suffix by using the existing insight.c:count_achievements helper. The target segment now matches through step 573 with all RNG and cursor output matching; one later step-574 final score-list screen remains a separate topten/endgame display gap outside this source scope.

source.branch: When should_query_disclose_option('c') requests a prompt, end.c:disclose counts achievements and appends " and achievements" only for a nonzero result. JavaScript now calls the existing count_achievements helper in the same branch and passes the conditional query to yn_function. The admitted Astral ending has ACH_UWIN, so it exercises the suffix branch.
callers: end.c:really_done calls disclose(how, taken) after final payment and inventory identification. js/end.js:really_done awaits the corresponding disclose function; this runtime path is exercised by the admitted endgame route.
dependencies: insight.c:count_achievements is already implemented by js/insight.js:count_achievements and tested for zero-terminated achievement lists in scripts/insight.test.mjs; disclose must use its return value to match C.

selectionReason: Selected the independently owned v79 wrong-altar amulet case. The admitted source replay reaches a fully matching wrong-god offer, then first diverges at the endgame conduct disclosure prompt. Prep’s accepted exact prefix proves screens, cursors, and all RNG calls match through zero-based step 570.
